label: X2 gate/tutoring inequality factorial — pre-declared analysis

H1_gate_prep.rule: both tut_rate and gate-adjacent tutoring material-positive (>=1pp, 90% CI excludes 0) in >=2/3 access levels at ban=0

H2_wealth_gap_widening.rule: top-bottom tutoring gap quota-bar material-positive in >=2/3 access levels at ban=0

H3_access_gradient.rule: wealth tutoring gap (access0.8 - access0.2) material-negative in BOTH gates at ban=0

gate_specificity_DiD.interpretation: if material-positive, the quota tutoring response is gate-concentrated (gate arithmetic); if not, it is broader
